mapper.sql: select g.guest_id, g.activity_id, g.guest_name, g.phone, g.org_name, g.title, g.english_name, g.guest_type, g.avatar, g.intro, g.need_hotel, g.check_in_date, g.check_out_date, g.id_card, g.attend_flag, g.sort_order, g.del_flag, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_by, g.update_time, g.remark, (select count(1) from yc_guest_trip t where t.guest_id=g.guest_id and t.del_flag='0') as trip_count, (select count(1) from yc_guest_fee f where f.guest_id=g.guest_id and f.del_flag='0') as fee_count from yc_guest g
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(case when attend_flag='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as attendCount, ifnull(sum(case when need_hotel='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as hotelCount from yc_guest where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_guest set del_flag='2' where guest_id in #{id}
update yc_guest_trip set del_flag='2' where guest_id in #{id}
update yc_guest_fee set del_flag='2' where guest_id in #{id}
